title: 第2章 才过去半天时间！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    负重栏内出现“普通酒水”的字样瞬间，许默迫不及待地选择了饮用，与此同时，他原本已经归零的饱腹值，终于上涨了10点。

    【饱腹：10/150】

    虽然只有不起眼的10点，但生命值总算是没有继续降低了。

    “妈的……”

    感受着稍稍减弱的饥饿感，许默有些如释重负的躺在草地上，他赌对了，酒的确能恢复饱腹值，虽然微乎其微，但关键时候能救命。

    劫后余生的许默，并没有过于庆幸。

    10点饱腹值，支撑不了多久，危机并没有彻底解除。

    稍作休息，他感觉体力值恢复的差不多了，又重新起身，继续开始在四周寻找起鸟粪来。

    终于，水潭四周的鸟粪被搜刮的一干二净，按照比例酿造制作酒水后，他终于将饱腹值恢复到了100点以上。

    除此外，负重栏内还剩下“普通酒水”X5。

    没有一口气喝完，是因为他发现自己制作的酒水，除了能恢复10点饱腹值外，还能额外恢复30点干渴值。

    刚才经过一番操作，干渴值已经到上限了，再喝就有点浪费了。

    好消息，食物危机暂时解除了。

    坏消息，周围能制作食物的资源，彻底用光了，许默必须转移探寻其他地方。

    他先是收集储存了足够多的水，单个负重栏的上限是“水X10”，他足足装了10栏，负重变成了13/15。

    准备完毕后，他重新踏进了迷雾。

    又走了一段路程后，周围的环境出现了变化，弥漫的雾气中开始出现零星的树木，大都形状怪诞，地面上偶尔也会出现鲜艳的花朵和更多的鸟粪。

    虽然依旧静谧，但至少多了几分生气，没有此前那么压抑了。

    许默没有闲着，尽可能地将鸟粪内的种子都收集起来，然后配合水全部制作成酒水，很快就塞满了整整两个负重栏。

    这时候，许默忽然注意到，远处的草地竟生长着一株蓝色的植物。

    “蘑菇！”

    这是他探索了这么久以来，发现的唯一或许能够食用的东西，尽管对方造型扭曲，而且浑身散发着诡异的蓝色。

    许默思索片刻后，打开【频道】。

    【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：6213】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The moment the words "ordinary drinks" appeared in the weight column, Xu Mo couldn't wait to drink. At the same time, his satiety value, which had already returned to zero, finally increased by 10 points.

【Fullness: 10/150】

Although it was only an inconspicuous 10 points, the health value finally did not continue to decrease.

"Damn..."

Feeling the slightly weakened hunger, Xu Mo lay down on the grass with some relief. He had made the right bet. Wine could indeed restore the satiety value. Although it was very small, it could save lives at critical times.

Xu Mo, who survived the disaster, was not overly grateful.

​ 10 points of fullness cannot be sustained for long, and the crisis has not been completely resolved.

After taking a short rest, he felt that his physical strength had almost recovered, so he stood up again and continued to look for bird droppings around him.

Finally, all the bird droppings around the pond were plundered. After brewing the wine according to the proportion, he finally restored the satiety value to more than 100 points.

In addition, there are "ordinary drinks" x5 left in the load column.

The reason he didn’t drink it all in one go was because he found that the wine he made could not only restore 10 satiety points, but also restore an additional 30 thirst points.

After some operations just now, the thirst value has reached the upper limit, and drinking anymore will be a bit wasteful.

Good news, the food crisis is temporarily over.

Bad news, the surrounding resources for making food have been completely used up, Xu Mo must move and explore other places.

He first collected and stored enough water. The upper limit of a single load-bearing column was "water x 10". He filled 10 columns, and the load became 13/15.

After preparations were completed, he stepped into the fog again.

After walking for a while, the surrounding environment changed. Scattered trees began to appear in the diffuse fog, most of them in weird shapes. Occasionally, bright flowers and more bird droppings appeared on the ground.

Although it is still quiet, it is at least a little more angry and not as depressed as before.

Xu Mo was not idle. He collected as many seeds as possible from the bird droppings and mixed them all with water to make wine. The two load-bearing columns were soon filled.

At this time, Xu Mo suddenly noticed that there was a blue plant growing on the grass in the distance.

"Mushrooms!"

This is the only thing he has found that may be edible after exploring for so long, even though it has a twisted shape and a weird blue color all over its body.

After Xu Mo thought for a moment, he opened the [Channel].
